entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand Pulse I bought. This is unbelievable.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Sterling. Order number is VF-8675309. And you're damn right I'm not satisfied. This thing is impossible.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Are you listening to me? It's a piece of garbage! The interface is so confusing, it's basically unusable. I expected more from a brand like VeloFit. This whole thing is just a complete waste of money.
I understand your frustration. The interface can have a learning curve. Could you tell me which feature you're finding hard to use? I might be able to walk you through it.

Walk me through it? I read the user manual cover to cover, and it didn't help one bit! I'm not wasting any more time on this. Either you process my return right now or you get me a manager who can. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys this thing again.
Okay, Mark, I understand. No need for a manager, I can handle this. Let me just check your purchase date against our return policy. One moment, please.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see here that your item was delivered 38 days ago. Looking at our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh. Well... okay then. See? Was that so hard? Finally. So what's the next step?

Not at all, I apologize for the initial trouble. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Okay, good. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
